Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Fish has an Earth-Feeder from a previous, successful Earth-Feeder
hunt. Can he play another Earth-Feeder as an action to hunt at +3
stealth and discard the second Earth-Feeder (the one played on the
action, rather than the one already on the vampire) if the action is
successful?

I assume he can. Otherwise, Earth-Feeder's text should probably be
written similarly to Repulsion's (ie, "This vampire cannot have or
play another Earth-Feeder").

John Eno
